note: Montmorency County does not zone; its townships (Briley, Montmorency, Hillman) and villages (Hillman, Atlanta) zone their own land. Their zoning maps are published only as PDF maps or images (Briley Township zoning map PDF, Montmorency Township ordinance referencing its map, Hillman Township map link with no service URL). The county GIS page links only the Beacon parcel viewer, a Schneider app with no public zoning-district REST service. ArcGIS searches for Montmorency zoning found no zoning district layer.
